# MediaPipe Tasks Vision (vendored)

- Package: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 1.1.1
- License: Apache-2.0
- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision
- Files: `vision_bundle.js` (IIFE, exposes the global `Vision`) and the
  SIMD / no-SIMD WebAssembly runtimes.

Regenerate with:

```sh
npm install
npm run sync:mediapipe
```

The person segmentation model is `src/assets/models/selfie_segmenter.tflite`
(MediaPipe Selfie Segmenter, Apache-2.0, ~244 KB).
